subject: Winthrop Street Phase Two Bike Lanes
overview: The Commission approved several handicap parking requests and finalized the design for the Winthrop Street bike lane expansion. Members opted for an alternative design that preserves on-street parking for residents and the American Legion while still implementing bike lanes and traffic calming measures.

items.title: Handicap Parking and Routine Business
items.summary: Approved meeting minutes for February and March, granted handicap parking signs for 26 Columbia Road, 42 Willard Ave, and 525 Main Street, and removed a resolved permit variance case from the table.

items.title: 564 High Street Parking Variance
items.summary: Denied a resident's request for a parking variance to Sagamore Avenue, granting instead an automatic variance for Boston Avenue and committing to traffic calming studies on High Street.

items.title: Winthrop Street Bike Lanes Phase Two
items.summary: Approved the expansion of bike lanes on Winthrop Street between Lawrence Road and South Street, selecting an alternative plan that preserves more on-street parking in response to neighborhood concerns. The body voted in segments to approve buffered lanes near the community garden and alternative designs near the American Legion and the Regency and Regal condominiums to maintain resident parking and restore specific right-turn lanes at Winthrop Circle.
